# Restore something you deleted

Nothing you delete is gone at once. Pages, labels and files go to the trash first. This guide shows how to get one
back.

After reading this guide, you will know:

- Where deleted things wait.
- How to restore one.
- How to delete one for good.
- How long the trash keeps things.

## 1. Open the trash

Choose **Trash** in the sidebar, under **Tools**. If it is empty, the page says so.

The list shows each item's title, its type (a page, a label or a file) and when it was deleted, newest first. The
**Kind** filter shows one sort at a time. An item that other content still uses says so beneath its title, for example
"Referenced by 2 other records".

## 2. Restore an item

Choose **Restore** on its row. It comes back where it was, with its address.

## 3. Delete for good

Choose **Delete** on its row. Nibble asks you to confirm with **Delete for good**.

> [!CAUTION]
> Deleting for good cannot be undone.

## 4. How long it waits

The trash is emptied 30 days after an item was deleted, unless your site says otherwise. Restore anything you want to
keep before then.

## 5. Put something in the trash

- A page or label: choose **Trash** at the top of its editor. See [Entries](entries.md#5-deleting-and-restoring).
- A file: see [Assets](assets.md#6-before-you-delete).
